title: Microsoft Takes Perception Agentic Security Platform Out of Preview
content_md: Microsoft used its Ignite 2026 conference on Tuesday to announce the general availability of Perception, a product designed for coordinating teams of AI agents to handle security tasks. Unveiled in July as Project Perception , the system has been in public preview inside Microsoft Defender since August. Playbooks direct the agents, which are split into red, blue and green teams. Red agents play the attacker and probe for weaknesses; blue agents handle detection, alert triage, and investigations; and green agents fix problems. The four blue team agents that are now generally available cover alert triage, attack investigation, detection authoring and threat intelligence. According to Microsoft, the Alert Triage Agent can handle roughly 80% of alerts in a typical Defender queue, based on an analysis of approximately 8 million alerts across its security products. The Recon Agent, one of the red team agents, is also generally available, and a Web App Pen Test Agent has entered preview. Two new green team playbooks work across Microsoft, AWS and Google Cloud. The agents behind them include Posture Prioritization, which is generally available, and Risk Reduction, which is in public preview. The Risk Reduction Agent can recommend vulnerability shielding when a fix isn’t immediately available.
